title: Zero-dimensional Hausdorff measure is counting measure: H⁰(S) = #S on ℝ^N
statement: For every N ∈ ℕ and every set S ⊆ ℝ^N = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) (arbitrary, not necessarily measurable), H⁰(S) = #S. Here H⁰ := μHE[0] is the zero-dimensional Euclidean Hausdorff (outer) measure, and #S := S.encard ∈ ℕ ∪ {∞} is the cardinality of S (∞ exactly when S is infinite), viewed in [0, ∞] via the coercion ℕ∞ → ℝ≥0∞. In particular, H⁰(S) = ∞ for every infinite S.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (S : Set (Rn N)), μHE[0] S = (S.encard : ℝ≥0∞)
